authority.user_scope: Wait for the other Codex real-response identification and MuJoCo handoff; reproduce execution and observation in Isaac, verify alignment, then train within a new inclusive10000 updates without a training wall limit
authority.new_spec_ledger_claim_or_watcher_created: spec/ledger/exclusive claim created; no watcher; unique public submission consumed
authority.prior_consumption: kept separately; no old balance transfer or refund
authority.current_training_action: continue its original frozen scope; no stop or hot edit authorized by this waiting plan

minimum_contents: executable adaptation code and parameter identity
adopted-target or final-motor-command input boundary, actual control configuration and time axis
encoder versus load versus virtual-state outputs, coupled hip-active mapping and units
sensor sampling, velocity estimation, filtering, quantization, delay and hold semantics
raw-data identity, fit and heldout experiments, free-evolution error and applicability limits
initial conditions and reconstruction of queues, filters and hidden execution states
handoff.scope: local equivalent response only; full robot implementation transfers only execution/observation subset with explicit mechanical assumptions

order: check control and observation boundaries and remove duplicated dynamics
compare causal CPU state updates and clock semantics
bounded Isaac response replay, vector-env isolation and partial-reset checks
fixed-Actor old-plant versus identified-plant closed-loop comparison
freeze the new runtime recipe, source identity, Critic state layout and independent ledger
double_count_checks: transport and response already contained in an equivalent model
local fitted load stiffness versus whole-body gravity, closure and spring
motor capability versus independent passive forces
rigid inertia versus armature or virtual actuator inertia
alignment.tolerances: declare from delivered sensor resolution, bandwidth and heldout scope before testing; not selected to pass current errors
alignment.physics_steps_and_storage: freeze bounded engineering allocations after handoff; no unbounded parameter scan

training_proposal.source_selection: same identified-plant evaluation; latest is not automatically best
training_proposal.critic_requirement: current true state, all causal hidden execution and observation states, queues and effective randomized parameters; freeze explicit layout after model delivery
training_proposal.nominal_execution: use delivered effective model; existing20/5/20/tau2 is a historical comparison, not an identified center
training_proposal.storage_requirement: estimate real artifact volume, atomic-save peak and terminal reserve against current free space before preparation

progressive_DR.amplitudes: freeze from delivered uncertainty and heldout residuals; unsupported ranges remain labeled engineering hypotheses
progressive_DR.unlock: clean identified baseline, small individual families, combinations, then wider ranges; retain clean anchors and assess DR at learned motion endpoints
progressive_DR.static_parameter_resampling: startup or reset with physically consistent parameters
progressive_DR.sensor_noise_sampling: at sensor sample generation; repeated packet reads keep the same noise sample
progressive_DR.gravity_noise: small physical rotation preserving unit norm

learning_signal.narrowing: only after complete persisted evidence; retain a wide contribution
